title: An Open Implementation Flow for the Xilinx Spartan-3E and Spartan-6 that Runs in the Browser, Checked Byte for Byte Against ISE
abstract: arXiv:2611.13008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The author describes an open implementation flow, from HDL to a programmable bitstream, for the Xilinx Spartan-3E (XC3S100E to XC3S1200E) and Spartan-6 (XC6SLX16, XC6SLX45), devices that only the discontinued ISE 14.7 supports. The flow runs unchanged in a web browser or in Node.js: Yosys and nextpnr compiled to WebAssembly, with nextpnr's Himbaechel framework given Spartan-3E and Spartan-6 architectures generated from Silinx's own device descriptions, bit database and timing model, and Silinx's own bitstream writer. The bit database was built by black-box observation of ISE's documented XDL and bitgen tools, using codeword-batched experiments; the router is given only switches whose bits were measured, and the writer refuses a feature it has not measured. ISE is the oracle: for the same placed and routed design, the bitstream is byte-identical to the one bitgen writes and ISE's DRC is clean. Placement and routing were first done by an

translated_title: 一个可在浏览器中运行的针对 Xilinx Spartan-3E 和 Spartan-6 的开源实现流程，并与 ISE 进行逐字节比对验证
translated_abstract: 作者描述了一个开源实现流程，涵盖从 HDL 到可编程比特流的完整过程，适用于 Xilinx Spartan-3E（XC3S100E 至 XC3S1200E）和 Spartan-6（XC6SLX16、XC6SLX45）器件——这些器件目前仅有已停产的 ISE 14.7 支持。该流程无需修改即可在网页浏览器或 Node.js 中运行：Yosys 和 nextpnr 被编译为 WebAssembly，其中 nextpnr 的 Himbaechel 框架配备了基于 Silinx 自身器件描述生成的 Spartan-3E 和 Spartan-6 架构、比特数据库和时序模型，以及 Silinx 自己的比特流写入器。比特数据库是通过对 ISE 文档化的 XDL 和 bitgen 工具进行黑盒观测建立的，采用码字分批实验方法；路由器仅使用比特位已被实际测量的开关，写入器会拒绝任何未经测量的特性。ISE 被作为参照标准（oracle）：对于相同的布局布线设计，该流程生成的比特流与 bitgen 写出的比特流逐字节相同，且 ISE 的 DRC 检查通过。布局和布线最初由（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个可在浏览器中运行的开源 FPGA 实现流程，为仅被停产的 ISE 工具链支持的 Xilinx Spartan-3E 和 Spartan-6 器件生成比特流，其输出与 ISE 生成的比特流逐字节完全一致。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an open-source FPGA implementation flow running in the browser that generates bitstreams for Xilinx Spartan-3E and Spartan-6 devices, verified byte-for-byte identical against the output of the discontinued ISE toolchain.
